title: Metabolism and nutrient deficiency in patients with chronic hemolytic anemias
summary: The study seeks to investigate whether patients with hereditary anemia are more likely to develop Nutritional deficiencies than healthy subjects of the same age and gender.

interventions.name: Not interventional. Eligible patients with chronic hemolytic anemia or healthy volunteers will be asked whether they are willing to participate. After giving consent, patients will provide an additional blood sample—up to 30 ml—during a blood draw already scheduled for routine care. We will perform
Healthy volunteers who are willing to participate will give a venous blood sample (maximum 30 ml), we will perform laboratory tests concerning vitamin status, amino acids and blood lipids.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with hereditary anemias or healthy control group.
Exclusion criteria:
Any comorbidities or conditions that make the patient or healthy control not suitable for participating in the study.
